# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 15 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Condo Market

- **River Modern sells 93% of units over debut weekend** - The private residential market maintained momentum in H1 2026, with River Modern's 455 units achieving a median price of S$3,229 psf at launch. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-condo-launches-2026/)

- **Dunearn House is the first condo to launch in Bukit Timah's Turf City precinct** - Indicative pricing starts from $1.475 million (at $2,799 psf), with two-bedder prices reported to undercut most other Bukit Timah launches and resale condos in the area. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/dunearn-house-condo-pricing-review/)

## HDB & Public Housing Updates

- **Community Care Apartments now open from age 55, with fees cut by up to 75%** - MOH, MND and HDB jointly announced the minimum eligible age for Community Care Apartments is lowered from 65 to 55, and mandatory monthly service fees are reduced by between 18% and 75%. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/community-care-apartments-seniors-from-age-55-fees-reduced-by-up-to-75/)

- **Gillman Barracks to be redeveloped into a new housing estate** - HDB studies confirm the 40-hectare site will be redeveloped for both public and private housing, with eight hectares of forest and 25 of 86 existing buildings retained. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/gillman-barracks-set-to-become-a-new-housing-estate/)

- **31-year-old Tampines executive flat transacts at S$1.24 million** - The resale deal marks another Tampines executive flat crossing the S$1.2 million threshold, with the unit carrying a 31-year-old lease at the time of sale. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/31-year-old-tampines-executive-hdb-flat-sets-towns-new-high-at-s1-24-million/)

## Infrastructure & Commercial

- **Circle Line Stage 6 opened for passenger service on 12 July 2026** - CCL6 completes the loop between HarbourFront and Marina Bay, connecting previously unlinked stations along the completed circle. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/why-renting-near-the-new-circle-line-stations-makes-sense-in-2026/)
